changelog: Fixed bootstrap install failing at verification ('Shell verification test failed: CANNOT LINK EXECUTABLE ... libandroid-support.so not found')

All Termux binaries now resolve their libraries from this app's own environment via LD_LIBRARY_PATH (the bootstrap binaries carry a hardcoded com.termux runpath that is unreadable under a different package name)
Fixed library resolution for the local server, terminal sessions, extension host, backup/restore scripts and MCP servers
termux-api dispatcher shebang and temp paths now follow the app's real package name
